npm.reason: The npm CLI, shipped unmodified as a separate program so agents can install packages through the egress proxy. Artistic-2.0 is OSI-approved and not copyleft for unmodified redistribution. Pending Chris's sign-off (KOBE-21).

qrcode-terminal.reason: Apache-2.0 declared with a non-SPDX label (npm dependency). Pending Chris's sign-off (KOBE-21).

spdx-exceptions.reason: SPDX exception-list data used by npm; attribution-only data license, not copyleft. Pending Chris's sign-off (KOBE-21).
